description: Runs independent adversarial review rounds with fresh internal subagents, or a user-approved local CLI fallback when internal subagents are unavailable, that attack artifact assumptions, happy paths, implementation completeness, target benefit realization, usability, ease of use, ease of understanding, failure scenarios, and evidence gaps through formal /vs_review/ reports and mandatory response closure.

changes: Expand unavailable-subagent fallback discovery across Claude, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi local agent commands.
Ask the user for another local agent command when no built-in fallback candidate is discovered.
Require verification and explicit approval for any user-recommended agent command before use.
Terminate the review workflow when no verified and approved reviewer is available.
